engine.obligationManifest: function obligationManifest(project){ensureShape(project);const currentIntake=intakeCoverageManifest(project),items=[];const add=(kind,sourceId,location,text,provenance={})=>{for(const [index,raw] of splitInputUnits(text).entries()){const value=String(raw),rawValueSha256=hash.sha256Text(value),obligationId='OBL-'+hash.sha256Value([kind,sourceId,location,index,rawValueSha256]).slice(0,20).toUpperCase();items.push({obligationId,kind,sourceId,location,index,text:value,rawValueSha256,provenance});}};for(const u of currentIntake.units)add('HUMAN_INPUT',u.unitId,u.sourcePath,u.rawValue,{inputVersion:u.inputVersion,intakeUnitId:u.unitId});for(const name of ['EXACT_DELIVERABLE_REQUESTED','INPUT_SET_CONTENTS'])add('STAGE01_JOB_DEFINITION','STAGE-01','/job/'+name,project.job?.[name],{inputVersion:currentIntake.inputVersion});for(const r of recordsForCurrentScope(project,'candidateRequirements'))add('EXTERNAL_CANDIDATE_OBLIGATION',recordId(r,'candidateRequirements'),String(recordValue(r,'SOURCE_LOCATION')||''),recordValue(r,'CANDIDATE_OBLIGATION'),{sourceId:String(recordValue(r,'SOURCE_ID')||r.relationships?.SOURCE_ID||'')});for(const r of recordsForCurrentScope(project,'research'))for(const f of ['MANDATORY_STATEMENTS','RECOMMENDATIONS','OPTIONAL_PRACTICES','PROHIBITIONS','EXCEPTIONS','DEPENDENCIES','APPLICABILITY_FACTS','RESTRICTIONS','INVALIDATING_MATERIAL'])add('SOURCE_RESEARCH',recordId(r,'research'),String(recordValue(r,'EXACT_PORTION_EXAMINED')||''),recordValue(r,f),{researchField:f,sourceId:String(recordValue(r,'SOURCE_ID')||r.relationships?.SOURCE_ID||'')});const scope=currentScope(project),manifestId='OBLIGATION-'+hash.sha256Value({scope,items:items.map(x=>[x.obligationId,x.rawValueSha256])}).slice(0,24).toUpperCase();return {schema:'closed-loop-obligation-manifest/1',manifestId,scope,items,itemCount:items.length,coverageRequired:items.length};}
engine.accountingClosure: function accountingClosure(manifest,accounting,stage){const expected=new Set((stage===1?manifest.units:manifest.items).map(x=>stage===1?x.unitId:x.obligationId)),seen=new Set(),issues=[];const rows=Array.isArray(accounting?.entries)?accounting.entries:[];for(const row of rows){const id=String(row?.inputId||'');if(!expected.has(id))issues.push('Unknown accounting identity '+id+'.');if(seen.has(id))issues.push('Duplicate accounting identity '+id+'.');seen.add(id);}for(const id of expected)if(!seen.has(id))issues.push('Missing accounting identity '+id+'.');return {complete:issues.length===0,covered:seen.size,total:expected.size,coverage:expected.size?seen.size/expected.size:1,issues};}

ingestionFunctions.validateHumanAnswer: function validateHumanAnswer(request,value,project){const type=request.answerType;const fail=m=>{const e=new Error(m);e.code='INVALID_HUMAN_ANSWER';e.requestId=request.requestId;throw e;};const missing=value===undefined||value===null||value===''||(type==='MULTI_CHOICE'&&Array.isArray(value)&&value.length===0);if(request.blocking!==false&&missing)fail(`Answer is required for ${request.requestId}.`);if(missing)return true;const allowed=safe(request.allowedValues);if(type==='TEXT'||type==='LONG_TEXT'){if(typeof value!=='string'||!value.trim())fail('A non-empty string is required.');}else if(type==='BOOLEAN'){if(typeof value!=='boolean')fail('A Boolean answer is required.');}else if(type==='NUMBER'){if(typeof value!=='number'||!Number.isFinite(value))fail('A finite numeric answer is required.');}else if(type==='CHOICE'){if(!allowed.includes(value))fail('The answer must be one allowed value.');}else if(type==='MULTI_CHOICE'){if(!Array.isArray(value)||value.some(v=>!allowed.includes(v))||new Set(value).size!==value.length)fail('Every selected answer must be a unique allowed value.');}else if(type==='DATE'){if(typeof value!=='string'||!/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(value))fail('An ISO YYYY-MM-DD date is required.');const parsed=new Date(`${value}T00:00:00Z`);if(Number.isNaN(parsed.getTime())||parsed.toISOString().slice(0,10)!==value)fail('A real ISO YYYY-MM-DD calendar date is required.');}else if(type==='FILE_REFERENCE'){if(typeof value!=='string'||!workflow.records(project,'artifacts',{active:true}).some(a=>workflow.recordId(a,'artifacts')===value))fail('A current canonical artifact ID is required.');}else fail(`Unsupported answer type ${type}.`);return true;}

fullCycleFunctions.runBatch: function runBatch(stage,operation,iterationId,candidateId){const slots=engine.reserveRunBatch(p,{stage,iterationId,count:10});for(const {runId,contextId} of slots){const run=engine.records(p,'runs').find(r=>engine.recordId(r,'runs')===runId),context=engine.records(p,'freshContexts').find(r=>engine.recordId(r,'freshContexts')===contextId);assert(engine.recordValue(run,'CANDIDATE_ID')===candidateId,`Run ${runId} did not derive the exact iteration candidate.`);assert(run.recordSha256===hash.recordSha256(run),`Run ${runId} reservation hash is stale.`);assert(context.recordSha256===hash.recordSha256(context),`Context ${contextId} reservation hash is stale.`);}for(let i=0;i<slots.length;i++){const {runId,contextId}=slots[i];engine.registerFreshContext(p,{stage,externalContextIdentifier:`EXTERNAL-CONTEXT-${stage}-${i+1}`,operatorLabel:'FULL_CYCLE'});const fulfilled=engine.records(p,'freshContexts').find(r=>engine.recordId(r,'freshContexts')===contextId);assert(fulfilled.recordSha256===hash.recordSha256(fulfilled),`Context ${contextId} hash is stale after registration.`);data(stage,{operation,scope:{runId,contextId},records:{runs:[recordProposal(schema,'runs',{targetId:runId,overrides:{FRESH_CONTEXT_RECORD:contextId,STARTED_AT:`T${i}`,ENDED_AT:`T${i+1}`,CONTAMINATION_CHECK:'NONE',TOOL_CONFIGURATION:'IDENTICAL',EXECUTION_STATUS:'COMPLETED',COMPLETE_OUTPUT:`complete-output-${stage}-${i}`,OUTPUT_ARTIFACT_IDENTITIES:'NONE',TOOL_FAILURES:'NONE',NOTES:'NONE'}})]}});}return slots;}

storeFunctions.parseLegacy: function parseLegacy(storage=globalThis.localStorage){const out=[],seen=new Set();if(!storage)return out;for(const key of LEGACY_KEYS){let raw=null;try{raw=storage.getItem(key);}catch(error){throw storageError(`Legacy project storage could not be read from ${key}: ${error.message||error}`,'LEGACY_MIGRATION_READ_FAILED');}if(!raw)continue;let parsed;try{parsed=JSON.parse(raw);}catch(error){throw storageError(`Legacy project storage ${key} contains malformed JSON: ${error.message||error}`,'LEGACY_MIGRATION_PARSE_FAILED');}const items=Array.isArray(parsed)?parsed:[parsed];for(let index=0;index<items.length;index++){const item=items[index];if(!item||typeof item!=='object'||Array.isArray(item))throw storageError(`Legacy project storage ${key}[${index}] is not a project object.`,'LEGACY_MIGRATION_INVALID_PROJECT');const id=projectIdentity(item);if(!id)throw storageError(`Legacy project storage ${key}[${index}] has no JOB_ID.`,'LEGACY_MIGRATION_INVALID_PROJECT');if(seen.has(id))continue;seen.add(id);out.push(item);}}return out;}
storeFunctions.writeAllLegacy: function writeAllLegacy(projects,storage){if(!storage)throw new Error('Legacy test storage is unavailable.');const payload=JSON.stringify(projects),prior=storage.getItem(STORE_KEY);try{fault('before-final-write');storage.setItem(STORE_KEY,payload);fault('after-final-write');return {changed:prior!==payload};}catch(error){try{if(prior===null)storage.removeItem(STORE_KEY);else storage.setItem(STORE_KEY,prior);}catch{}throw error;}}
